messages:
morgan: Quick sync — want to lock the onboarding ops slate and the set of 'burning questions' for the next DP wave. Need recruitment criteria, incentive tiers, measurement hooks, and clear exit criteria. Rapid pass?
alejandra: +1. legal sent new guidance on incentive caps; can we list tiered non-monetary and monetary options?
sam_k: I sketched recruitment buckets earlier: product PMs, platform integrators, and regulated customers. Target seats = 30.
vlad: Measurement hooks: automated prompt-eval flows, a short weekly NPS, and 15-min qualitative interviews. Also require rollback SLA if core quality drops.
emily_pd: Love the interviews. Weekly auto-eval needs a baseline + pass/fail thresholds, and explicit canary triggers.
morgan: Draft checklist:
```
- Seats: 30 (10 PM / 10 Integrators / 10 Regulated)
- Recruitment docs: short use-case, integration timeline, contact person
- Incentives: credits (tier A), $200 gift card cap (tier B), extended premium support (tier C)
- Eval hooks: weekly automated prompt set, 15-min interview, monthly NPS + churn survey
- Instrumentation: log model variant, quant profile, and route for each request
- Failure tags: hallucination | latency | formatting | auth-failure
- Exit criteria: <60% pass on core prompts after 2 consecutive weeks -> pause cohort
- Rollout: canary 10% -> 50% if pass -> 100% at 90% pass
```
alejandra: Legal note: gift cards capped at $200/org; prefer credits or support as primary incentive. Need consent language for data capture.
sam_k: Outreach cadence proposal: email invite, reminder (48h), final confirm (72h). I'll own messaging.
vlad: Ops constraints: dedicated SRE on-call for the first 72 hours; canary route must fallback to hosted variant. Also ensure autoscaling buffers for burst tests.
emily_pd: For the automated eval: tag failures by mode (vlad's idea) and correlate with quantization/model variant. I'll publish the prompt set and thresholds tonight.
morgan: ops-bot, can you scaffold the invite channel and drop the template?
ops-bot: @morgan created channel #dp-wave-8-invite and seeded a draft invite template (id: dp-invite-8) :white_check_mark:
alejandra: Also add a brief opt-out/exit survey to capture churn reasons (product mismatch vs friction).
sam_k: Added: we'll collect that within 48h of opt-out. Also propose short intake form to qualify seat fit.
vlad: Reminder: tag each eval run with infra snapshot (kernel selection, GPU type) so SRE can reproduce regressions.
emily_pd: One question: include a pricing-sensitivity test in this wave?
morgan: Not this wave. Wave 1 = fidelity & stability. Wave 2 = pricing A/B. Action items: 
- sam_k: finalize recruitment script + cadence (48h)
- emily_pd: upload prompt set + thresholds (48h)
- alejandra: confirm legal wording on incentives & data capture (24h)
- vlad: confirm SRE coverage + fallback routes (24h)
- ops-bot: keep invite channel seeded (done)
If no objections I'll lock this slate EOD. :calendar:
alejandra: No objections pending legal sign-off.
sam_k: Good with seats and cadence.
vlad: I'll schedule the oncall.
emily_pd: Smoke-tested the prompts, will finish thresholds.
morgan: Locking for now. Will reconvene after the 48h actions. Thanks all! :tada:
